title: The Day of the Golden Scarf
skyStory: The moon has strutted into Leo, seventy-eight percent lit and wearing sunglasses at night. Leo moons crave applause. They want a stage, a spotlight and somebody to say bravo at the right moment. Leo is also ruled by the Sun, so tonight the moon is borrowing a golden glow and pretending it was always hers. Nobody is brave enough to correct her.

reading: Around 10:15 this morning a stranger in a mustard-gold scarf will hold a door for you and say 'after you' with a theatrical little bow. You will laugh, because who bows anymore? Leo moons, that is who.

Later, Nancy will message you about her day. A stranger. A gold scarf. A theatrical bow. The same two words. Don't even scream, but definitely scream a little. Two strangers, two towns, one scarf colour. The universe has clearly hired a costume department. Accept the door, accept the bow, and accept the [[Three of Cups]] energy: somewhere, someone is celebrating you.
joel.mission: Hold a door for someone today with an unnecessary flourish, and do it with a perfectly straight face.
joel.omen: Something gold glinting on the ground. A small gift is on its way, probably in the form of an excellent compliment.

reading: Leo is a fire sign and today it is lending you a little stage presence. People will turn when you walk in. Somebody will laugh at your joke before you get to the punchline. A stranger in a gold scarf will hold a door and bow.

When you tell Joel about the scarf and he sends back his own gold-scarf stranger, bow and all, give it the full ΔΕΣ treatment: hands up, eyes wide, maybe a spin in the kitchen. Then accept the spotlight. [[Strength]] is a lion at peace, and it says you are allowed to be adored without earning it first.
nancy.mission: Accept the next compliment you get with a small curtsy or bow, in full view of everyone.
nancy.omen: A cat sitting in a sunbeam like royalty. You, too, are allowed to take the warm spot.

together.text: Write a short review of each other as if the other were a stage show. Five stars, one dramatic quote, one standing-ovation moment. Joel reviews Nancy, Nancy reviews Joel. Read them out loud, gold scarf optional but strongly recommended.
